text.p: (In million U.S. dollars, except per share data)

NOTES: The unaudited pro forma results of operations presented above for 1996 reflect the company's restructuring as if it had occurred on January 1, 1996 after including the adjustments for interest expense on restructuring debt, amortization of goodwill and restructuring-related financing costs, and the elimination of the management fees paid to the partners of the network prior to the restructuring.

The unaudited pro forma results of operations do not purport to represent what Univision's results of operations would actually have been if these transactions in fact had occurred on the date assumed or to project results of operations for any future date or periods.

(a) As a result of the corporate restructuring in the fourth quarter of 1996, the net program license fee payable to Univision's programming partners, Televisa and Venevision, increased from 9.8 percent to 13.0 percent and 9.5 percent to 13.0 percent of net revenues for the three and six months ended June 30, 1996 and 1997, respectively. Had the revised license fee been in effect in 1996, EBITDA would have increased by 24 percent, from $36.5 million to $45.4 million, and by 22 percent, from $55.3 million to $67.5 million for the three and six months ended June 30, 1996 and 1997, respectively.

(b) Excluding the extraordinary losses for the three and six months ended June 30, 1996, which related to the pro forma repurchase and defeasance of the outstanding 11.75 percent senior subordinated notes at January 1, 1996 of $18.6 million, net of the related tax benefit thereon of $5.3 million, the proforma earnings per share for the three and six months in 1996 would have been $0.18 and $0.14, respectively. The full tax benefit was recorded in the second quarter of 1996 since the company had a proforma loss in the first quarter.
Full company name is Univision Communications Inc.
